text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly before the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet talk 
together inside the planetarium.

Daiwa Scarlet, who has walked a steady 
path and meticulously connected the lines 
of her constellation.

On the other hand, Vodka connected the 
"dots" through unorthodox experiences and 
drew a constellation all her own.

Two clashing constellations spark brightly 
toward the grand stage.
